newsitem.title: USA: AIMCO to buy apartment management company.
newsitem.headline: AIMCO to buy apartment management company.

text.p: Apartment Investment and Management Co said Friday it agreed to acquire the apartment management business of Walters Management Co.

The company said it would pay $132,000 at the closing of the deal, payable in operating partnership units (OPUs) of AIMCO Properties LP and up to $108,000 in additional OPUs during the next three years.
It said it would merge the San Diego, Calif., business into Walters/Property Asset Management Services LP to manage 3,485 units in the southern part of the state.
Walters used to manage 2,805 apartment units in 25 properties for 22 third-party owners.
"The acquisition of Walters Management Co enhances our third-party management capabilities in Southern California and provides a launching pad for additional acquisitions," it said.
Apartment Investment and Management is a real estate investment trust based in Denver, Colo., that holds a portfolio of apartments in the middle market.
